text: A particle P of mass 0.2 kg is released from rest at a point O on a smooth horizontal surface. A
horizontal force of magnitude te N directed away from O acts on P, where v m s is the velocity of
P at time t s after release. Find the velocity of P when t = 2. [4]
A uniform solid cone has height 0.6 m and base radius 0.2 m. A uniform hollow cylinder, open at both
ends, has the same dimensions. An object is made by putting the cone inside the cylinder so that the
base of the cone coincides with one end of the cylinder (see diagram, which shows a cross-section).
The total weight of the object is 60 N and its centre of mass is 0.25 m from the base of the cone.
Calculate the weight of the cone. [3]
A particle P of mass 0.4 kg is released from rest at a point O on a smooth plane inclined at 30Å to the
horizontal. P moves down the line of greatest slope through O. The velocity of P is v m s when its
displacement from O is x m. A retarding force of magnitude 0.2v N acts on P in the direction PO.
dv
One end of a light elastic string of natural length 0.4 m and modulus of elasticity 8 N is attached to a
fixed point O on a smooth horizontal plane. The other end of the string is attached to a particle P of
mass 0.2 kg which moves on the plane in a circular path with centre O. The speed of P is v m s and
the extension of the string is x m.
A small ball B is projected from a point O which is h m above a horizontal plane. At time 2 s after
projection B has speed 18 m s and is moving in the direction 30Å above the horizontal.
